address: Boutique Hotel Amax, aleja Spacerowa 7, Mikołajki, 11-730, Poland
bio: Set within the Boutique Hotel Amax at the heart of the picturesque Masurian Lake District, this slightly Baroque-looking restaurant sits on the shores of Lake Mikołajskie. Grab a table by the window or on the terrace to make the most of the views. The chefs proudly use the local larder in their full-flavoured dishes, including fish from the lake itself, while their own smokehouse is used for the likes of standout smoked eel with red cabbage smurkul.
